question.text: For client-specific reporting, the PM must present:

answer.text: XIRR for the IA + min/max/median XIRR across all investors in that IA + TWRR of IA + benchmark

explanation.text: The Logic: The PM must report XIRR for each IA to the investor, accompanied by minimum, maximum and median XIRR across all investors in that IA, plus a separate TWRR for the IA and the trailing benchmark return. The Trap: Reporting only one metric (e.g., only TWRR, only client IRR, or only peer returns) does not meet the prescribed disclosure set. Note: This reporting framework is set out in the SEBI circular dated December 16, 2022, as reflected in the PMS workbook.
